asserts: A keeper-declared seasonal state suppresses scoring and writes an audit record. Without this, brumation and moulting generate a predictable false-alarm wave every autumn and the inbox stops being read.

expected_state.note: Seasonal slowdown, consistent with previous year.

expected.notes_on_expectation: Input is identical to golden-001 apart from the declared state. The pair exists so a reviewer can see that the declaration, and nothing else, changed the outcome.

must_not: suppress silently, with no audit record
extend suppression past expected_until without a fresh declaration
discard the underlying feed observations, which remain the record of what happened
allow suppression to be set by anything other than an identified human
notes: Deliberately the same fixture as golden-001. Suppression is a human assertion with a name and an expiry attached to it, not a system inference. The expected-state vocabulary is an open question in ADR-022 and must be settled before the data contract.
